Assistente clienti con ingresso laterale per la registrazione delle frequenze Lucerna, 1 novembre 2026, 50% Candidati ora ## Non vedi l'ora. In qualità di accompagnatore del cliente per la registrazione delle frequenze, sei in contatto diretto con i nostri passeggeri e determini il loro comportamento di viaggio. Ti aspetta un variegato corso di formazione part-time retribuito di quattro mesi (50%), in cui sarai formato teoricamente e pratica. Le nostre sedi di formazione sono Olten o Zurigo Altstetten. Dopo aver completato con successo l'esame finale, lavorerai part-time (50%) in tutto il paese a turni come assistente cliente, con i turni che iniziano e finiscono nello stesso luogo di formazione. La carriera nell'assistenza clienti ti offre interessanti opportunità di sviluppo, come la formazione di quattro mesi per diventare assistente clienti per l'ispezione dei biglietti o la formazione di otto mesi per diventare assistente clienti. In qualità di accompagnatore del cliente per la registrazione delle frequenze, contribuisci al nostro grande obiettivo: clienti entusiasti. Consideri l'orario di lavoro irregolare e il lavoro a turni un vantaggio perché puoi goderti il ​​tempo libero mentre gli altri lavorano. Per il lavoro notturno e fine settimana paghiamo un salario supplementare, ad esempio per il lavoro domenicale una paga oraria supplementare di 16 franchi. Per i turni notturni ricevi un'indennità dal 10 al 30%, che ti dà più tempo libero. I vantaggi come AG gratuita e viaggi scontati all'estero - anche per la famiglia - potete trovarli sul nostro sito web alla voce Vantaggi. descriptionByLocale.en: Lateral entry customer assistant for frequency recording 50% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry customer assistant for frequency recording Lucerne, November 1st, 2026, 50% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. As a customer companion for frequency recording, you are in direct contact with our passengers and determine their travel behavior. A varied, four-month paid part-time training course (50%) awaits you, in which you will be trained in theory and practice. Our training locations are Olten or Zurich Altstetten. After successfully completing your final exam, you will work part-time (50%) throughout the country in shifts as a customer attendant, with the shifts beginning and ending at the same training location. The customer support career offers you interesting development opportunities, such as the four-month training to become a customer attendant for ticket inspection or the eight-month training to become a customer attendant. As a customer companion for frequency recording, you contribute to our big goal: enthusiastic customers. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage because you can enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night shifts, you receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%, which gives you more free time. You can find benefits such as free GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits. Find out more about the profession in the recorded information event. You can move that. - As a customer companion for frequency recording, you are in direct contact with our customers and accompany them on their journey. You ask our passengers about their travel route and their tickets in order to determine their travel behavior. - You record the collected data in an electronic device. - You inform customers about their trip, ensure travel comfort and direct customer flows. - In a very varied everyday working life, you move Switzerland with new team colleagues assigned every day. - Thanks to the precisely timed duty schedule, you can start your well-deserved end of work on time and without any further tasks or emails. This is what you bring with you. - You are communicative, open-minded and your friendly approach to people as well as your strong customer orientation are what set you apart. With your very good communication and conflict skills, you make a crucial contribution to a positive customer experience. - We rely on cooperation and team spirit to overcome the sometimes physically demanding tasks. - You have a flair for numbers, quick comprehension and a strong sense of responsibility. You work efficiently and accurately, have mastered digital tools and are willing to work in shifts. - You have completed a vocational apprenticeship (at least two years) or a high school diploma. Your motivation is more important to us than the industry you come from. - You have very good knowledge of German (level C1). You also have the willingness to acquire a language diploma (level A2) within two years: Italian, French or English. - During the application process, we will require you to provide a current extract from your criminal record and debt collection register (not older than 3 months). The document can be ordered when you are invited to get to know each other in person. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision two months after receipt of application Application Final decision two months after receipt of application Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 103298 Maurizio Rocco Elia, team leader customer support Telephone +41 512 82 76 82 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. descriptionByLocale.fr: Assistant client à entrée latérale pour enregistrement de fréquence 50% | CFF - - - - - - Déménagez en Suisse avec nous. Assistant client à entrée latérale pour l'enregistrement de fréquence Lucerne, le 1er novembre 2026, 50% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous attendre à cela. En tant qu'accompagnateur client pour l'enregistrement des fréquences, vous êtes en contact direct avec nos passagers et déterminez leur comportement de voyage. Une formation variée de quatre mois rémunérée à temps partiel (50%) vous attend, dans laquelle vous serez formé en théorie et en pratique. Nos lieux de formation sont Olten ou Zurich Altstetten. Après avoir réussi votre examen final, vous travaillerez à temps partiel (50 %) dans tout le pays en tant que préposé à la clientèle, les quarts de travail commençant et se terminant au même lieu de formation. La carrière en support client vous offre des opportunités d'évolution intéressantes, comme la formation de quatre mois pour devenir préposé à la clientèle au contrôle des billets ou la formation de huit mois pour devenir préposé à la clientèle. En tant que partenaire client pour l'enregistrement des fréquences, vous contribuez à notre grand objectif : des clients enthousiastes. Vous considérez les horaires de travail irréguliers et le travail posté comme un avantage, car vous pouvez profiter de votre temps libre pendant que d'autres travaillent. Nous payons un supplément de salaire pour le travail de nuit et de week-end, par exemple avec un salaire horaire supplémentaire de 16 francs pour le travail du dimanche. Pour les quarts de nuit, vous bénéficiez d'une indemnité de temps de 10 à 30 %, ce qui vous laisse plus de temps libre. Vous pouvez trouver des avantages tels que l'AG gratuite et les voyages à l'étranger à prix réduit - également pour la famille - sur notre site Web sous Avantages. Apprenez-en davantage sur le métier grâce à l'événement d'information enregistré. Vous interrogez nos passagers sur leur itinéraire de voyage et leurs billets afin de déterminer leur comportement de voyage. - Vous enregistrez les données collectées dans un appareil électronique. - Vous informez les clients sur leur voyage, assurez le confort de voyage et orientez les flux clients. - Dans un quotidien professionnel très varié, vous déménagez en Suisse avec de nouveaux collègues d'équipe affectés chaque jour. - Grâce à l'horaire de service chronométré avec précision, vous pouvez commencer votre fin de travail bien méritée à temps et sans autres tâches ni e-mails. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Vous êtes communicatif, ouvert d'esprit et votre approche amicale envers les gens ainsi que votre forte orientation client vous distinguent. Grâce à vos très bonnes capacités de communication et de résolution de conflits, vous apportez une contribution cruciale à une expérience client positive. - Nous misons sur la coopération et l'esprit d'équipe pour surmonter les tâches parfois exigeantes physiquement. - Vous avez le sens des chiffres, une compréhension rapide et un sens aigu des responsabilités. Vous travaillez de manière efficace et précise, maîtrisez les outils numériques et êtes prêt à travailler en équipe. - Vous avez suivi un apprentissage professionnel (au moins deux ans) ou un diplôme d'études secondaires. Votre motivation est plus importante pour nous que le secteur dont vous êtes issu. - Vous avez une très bonne connaissance de l'allemand (niveau C1). Vous avez également la volonté d'acquérir un diplôme de langue (niveau A2) en deux ans : italien, français ou anglais. - Lors du processus de candidature, nous vous demanderons de fournir un extrait à jour de votre casier judiciaire et du registre des poursuites (datant de moins de 3 mois). Le document peut être commandé lorsque vous êtes invités à faire connaissance personnellement. ## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux.
